game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool, a pool below a waterfall: the herbalist must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the herbalist moves exactly n steps toward the seed vault.
theme: Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool: a pool below a waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Waterfall Pool, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the herbalist moves exactly n steps toward the seed vault. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about steps_left to power up the herbalist and open the seed vault.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Waterfall Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wolves in Waterfall Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
